about: Tagout held-out set #3, written Oct 30 2026 (03:15-03:40 IST) and pushed with the tag prereg-2026-10-30 before any arm runs on it. Four recalls posted Oct 15-29 that bound their codes or dates instead of listing them, each with one recalled unit inside the bound and one neighbour outside it: a made-date window (CPSC 27-054), two made-date windows with a gap (CPSC 27-041), a serial-number interval (FDA Z-0151-2027) and a serial run printed as 'X through Y' (FDA Z-0138-2027). None of these recalls is in another case file. Caveat stated before the run: the bound and window rules in lib/match.ts were written on Oct 30 after held-out set #2, and scripts/bound-coverage.mts ran them over every 2026 CPSC and openFDA notice, these four included, but the regexes were widened only for FDA food best-by phrasings, none of which is here. Ground truth comes from the agency records, checked by eval/verify-holdout3.mjs with no Tagout code.
run: npx tsx --conditions=react-server eval/run.ts tagout --cases cases-holdout3.json --results results-holdout3 --today 2026-10-30 --cap 0.30 --keyless --tavily-wait 30; the same with fixed-plan-nano and --cap 0.05; node eval/score.mjs --cases cases-holdout3.json --verified verified-holdout3.json --results results-holdout3 --out holdout3-summary.json --first none
